params.text:
Chapter 1 / Project evidence
The report separates observations from proposals. A workshop note is evidence that a discussion occurred, while an estimate is an input to a decision. Neither should be rewritten as an approved commitment. Each section records the source, the responsible reviewer and the date when the information was checked.
Collect the input documents before laying out the chapter. Preserve the source wording and keep a short record of missing facts. If a statement has no supporting source, label it as a question for the owner. Do not invent dates, quantities or endorsements to make a page look complete. Review the longest paragraph before fixing the final type size.
Flow the chapter through linked text frames rather than copying its body onto several pages. The first frame contains the complete original story. Empty continuation frames receive the remaining text in order. After a change, compare the entire saved story with the input so that a missing middle paragraph cannot pass merely because the heading and final line remain.
Page breaks are layout decisions that affect the table of contents. The chapter title uses a distinct paragraph style; body paragraphs use the body style. A contents generator should select the heading style rather than matching words that happen to look like headings. Confirm the resulting page labels after all inserted pages and text reflow.
Before delivery, reopen the editable project and inspect both the story and its frames. Export an IDML copy for another layout system and a PDF proof for review. A successful export does not show that the typesetting, accessibility or print conditions have been accepted. Keep those checks visible in the handoff note.

params.text:
Chapter 2 / Review and handoff
Reviewers check source statements, dates and responsibilities before approving the proof. Editorial corrections remain separate from layout changes. When an appendix is added, regenerate the contents from the current heading positions and inspect the actual printed labels. Do not maintain a second guessed list of page numbers.
The editable handoff includes the native project, IDML, a review PDF and any permitted linked assets. Record font restrictions and unresolved questions. Preserve a source note with its reference in the chapter, then reopen the saved project to verify that the note text and anchor survived. This sample is a workflow fixture, not an approved project report.
